Outstanding Vietnamese Food
Feb 2019 • Couples
Located out near Noi Bai Airport, this restaurant is really excellent. This is not street food but a real restaurant. And, the first thing diner's notice is that, unlike most places in Hanoi, there are actual parking spots in front of the restaurant. That was novel! Anyway, the staff was helpful and patient as we looked through the menu. The menu was extensive but we quickly picked a few dishes. I have to say, everything we got was exceptional. We got a beef with morning glory dish, a chicken stew (with bones, normal here but something I don't prefer). And, we got a corn, chicken soup. I got the feeling that the place doesn't draw too many foreigners due to it's location far from anything touristy. But, that can be a good thing. Diners at another table even offered to share some of their booze with us (an old man presented a colored liquid poured from a repurposed water bottle!) Normally, I would have accepted but we were on a 50 mile bike ride and I didn't think it was a good idea.

But the restaurant was great. The bathroom was clean and the food and service was excellent.
